verdict.rationale: DeepInfra explicitly offers a priority service tier documented to deliver faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput during peak demand, plus a flex tier for lower-cost/slower workloads, and community evidence notes cold-start latency is typically under 10s for popular models. However, there are no independent benchmarks or hands-on throughput/latency numbers corroborating these claims beyond vendor docs. Missing for 10: independent latency/throughput benchmarks, hands-on performance corroboration, and quantified TTFT/throughput figures.
